I inspected the two-page excerpt you supplied. Summary of the explicit claims in that excerpt:

- Revenue increased 12% year over year. (Page 1)  
- Operating costs fell 3% after consolidation. (Page 2)

Uncertainty / limits: I only reviewed the supplied excerpt (pages 1–2). The excerpt does not include absolute amounts, the baseline figures, the exact reporting period beyond “year over year,” or details on what “consolidation” entailed, so I cannot verify those details or provide additional context beyond the quoted percentage changes. If you want, provide more pages or the full report and I can expand the summary and cite supporting tables or notes.
